responseScene.visual: Full-frame LTX I2V plate, edge to edge, no inset and no overlay. Inanimate macro still life: one green olive on natural linen under soft raking cinematic-dark light, shallow depth of field. The olive makes one straight roll left to right, then settles completely still and holds for the final two seconds. No hands, no people, no props entering frame, no text, no inset keyframe image.
